references.text: The priest shall isolate the person with the disease for seven days—the same procedure of a seven-day isolation is used for skin ailments.
Describes a similar situation where the priest examines whether the ailment is deeper than the skin and lacks dark hair, followed by isolation.
A seven-day isolation period is also used to examine leprosy in garments.
The priest shall shut up the house for seven days—the same principle of a seven-day observation applies to assess uncleanness.
Miriam was shut out from the camp for seven days because of leprosy—illustrating the practical application of the isolation laws.
